hadith:
Transferance of a Debt from One Person to Another (Al-Hawaala) - Narrated Abu Huraira:

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Procrastination (delay) in paying debts by a wealthy person is injustice. So, if your debt is transferred from your debtor to a rich debtor, you should agree."
message: When we witness the full moon's splendor, let it remind us of Allah's perfect sovereignty—Al Qahhaar, the Subduer—whose dominion encompasses all creation. Just as the Prophet ﷺ taught us that delaying payment of debts by the wealthy is a form of injustice, we should honor our obligations with integrity, submitting our affairs to Allah's will and trusting in His ultimate authority over all matters.
name:
Al Qahhaar - الْقَهَّارُ - The Subduer

The name Al Qahhaar emphasizes Allah's sovereignty and ability to dominate all beings and situations. It reflects His authority and the inevitable defeat of all that opposes His will. The name inspires believers to submit to Allah's will, reminding them of His might and the transient nature of worldly power.
verse:
Al-Inshiqaq - The Sundering - 84:18

And by the moon when it waxes full!
